paperReadings.note: The course publishes no slides publicly, so its course material is the per-lecture paper reading list on the site. Papers are cited at their original URL (sources.md); the PDFs are on the build machine under raw/pdfs/ and gitignored. Only the papers the site lists for a lecture are ingested for that lecture. Lecture 1 lists none.

caveats: PARTIAL: covers catalog lecture 1 (Course Overview) of 9. Do not cite this KB as covering CS329A as a whole; it has no treatment of any later lecture or of any paper reading.

Lecture 1 is transcript-only: the course publishes no slides and the site lists no paper readings for it. Every claim on its pages is cited to a transcript timestamp or, on the logistics page, to the course website. figuresAudited is false because there are no figures in this KB at all, not because figures went unchecked.
